capabilities.description: Register all contract documents (the contract excerpt, BOQ, drawings, ITPs, correspondence) with versioning, provenance, and clause/item citations so the uploaded contract and BOQ remain the declared source of record.

Ingest harbourline_boq.xlsx as the priced schedule (Preliminaries P1-P5, Earthworks E1-E5), resolve rates and quantities into a BOQ model, and serve it as the authoritative basis for measurement and claims.

Build interim payment certificates from BOQ items and measured progress, apply 5% retention per Clause 14.3, track 50% release at Taking-Over and 50% at end of the Defects Notification Period (Clause 11.1), and route certificates through approval.

Track the 730-day Time for Completion (Clause 8.2) and compute delay damages at 0.1% of the Accepted Contract Amount per day, capped at 10% (Clause 8.7), with the Accepted Contract Amount and the 10% Performance Security (Clause 4.2) carried as governed parameters.
Log Inspection and Test Plan records against BOQ work items and stages, capture inspection outcomes and sign-offs, and link each record to the document register and the claims they support.
Maintain a tamper-evident ledger of every claim, certificate, delay-damages calculation, and ITP record, with an immutable audit chain so any figure can be traced back to its clause or BOQ citation.
Present the certified amount, retention held and released, delay-damages exposure against the cap, ITP status, and document register health for the contract administrator and commercial manager.

summary: A contracts-administration platform for the Harbourline Civil Works project that runs the commercial and quality record for the job off a single source of record: the uploaded contract excerpt and BOQ. It covers progress claims built from BOQ quantities and measured progress, retention and payment certification per contract Clause 14.3, delay-damages tracking against Clause 8.2 and 8.7, QA/ITP records tied to work items, and a document register of every contract artifact.
